question: 25.12 × 37.5 = 942. What is the value of 2512 × 0.00375?
solution:
**Given:**

25.12 × 37.5 = 942

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6dff4d58ce66b38e0cdda1b0a721fa32c2ef301f704e653b2f493673a6e332b.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2512 × 0.00375 = (25.12 × 100) × (37.5 × 1/10000)

⇒ (25.12 × 37.5) × 10² × 10⁻⁴

⇒ 942 × 10⁻²

⇒ 942 × 0.01

⇒ 9.42

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
